# Your Feedback @ NTU Psychology

- Our current courses are informed by previous student feedback.
- We rely on your feedback to help us optimise our modules and courses
  - in real-time
  - and for future students.
- When we ask you for feedback, we will always let you know what we found and how we have used it on your course.
- All responses are anonymous.

# Your Feedback in PSYC40940: Visualisation of Behavioural Data and Data Dashboards

- I'll be asking you for your brief comments:
  - **Now:** As we set out on the module, but only if you have questions/suggestions.
  - **Mid-module:** When you have more experience of the module to feedback on, but still early enough so that we can implement change.
  - **End of the Year:** A single course survey about all of your modules to inform future decisions.
- What cannot be changed this year:
  - Module assessment
  - Module structure
